input: Scheduled routine: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products in production (owner's standing ventures brief)
task: xer-schedule-check: contractor's monthly schedule narrative drafted from two P6 updates

errors.what: guide quoted 'seven activities' missed after the narrative merged a start-and-finish pair into one line; guides.test caught it

doc_friction.issue: Start here pointed at open-tennis-robots whose one buildable item is 'a deep socket on an extension' in CAD; five sessions in two days already left the row for the same reason (no market path), and the row's buildable text still invites it.

deviations.why: The brief asks for revenue-generating products; the row's only buildable item is a CAD spanner detail with no user or market effect, as five earlier runs also judged.
deviations.did: Took xer-schedule-check (flagship 13), the buildable row with the clearest paid comparables (Acumen Fuse, SmartPM, consultants), and built the contractor's side of the monthly update.
deviations.result: Landed narrative.mjs, page section, CLI flag, guide page and an 18-run eval on six public files; 365 venture tests pass.

goal: Add a contractor-side deliverable (the monthly schedule narrative most specs require) to the flagship with the clearest paid market among the buildable rows
notes: Verification: python3 platform/ci/run_venture_tests.py xer-schedule-check -> ok (365 tests); node eval/narrative-check.mjs on the six corpus-fetch XERs -> 18 of 18 runs pass (12 planted slips, 15 planted lags, all named with fill-ins); Playwright on the page: example pair -> Download narrative (text/HTML) works, no console errors; check_posts ok; validate.py ok. venture-preflight run in background (see PR). Narrative never invents causes: every cause/reason is a [FILL IN] marker, counted and highlighted. Not yet read by a real scheduler.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a senior scheduler/developer building the narrative generator, eval on six files, guide and page section

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
